page_title: FIO 1-0 CAG | Fiorentina v Cagliari 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Poor challenge! Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is penalised for tripping and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle.
90+4' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) gets booked for the first time in this match.
87' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
83' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Antoine Makoumbou and he is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) will replace Lucas Beltran.
83' Davide Nicola is stunned as referee Marco Piccinini shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
82' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
80' The resulting corner from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is cleared by the defence.
80' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
75' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
73' Nadir Zortea goes off the pitch and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) comes on.
72' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Razvan Marin is replaced by Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
67' Here is a change. Yacine Adli is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
67' Riccardo Sottil comes off the pitch to be replaced by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina).
66' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
65' It looks like Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) saw red with that tackle. Marco Piccinini won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
60' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
60' Foul! Razvan Marin (Cagliari) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
60' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
58' Dodo (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Adam Obert cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moise Kean (Fiorentina) replacing Christian Kouame.
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jonathan Ikone as he is replaced by Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina).
56' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
56' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cagliari.
53' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
52' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) tries to find Jonathan Ikone, but he puts too much power on the pass.

47' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Alen Sherri is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
46' Substitution. Nicolas Viola walks off the pitch and Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Marco Piccinini has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
43' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
42' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Adam Obert (Cagliari) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yerry Mina (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
33' A dangerous towering header by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
33' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
32' The resulting corner from Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
31' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
31' The game has begun to heat up. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
29' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
29' A clumsy foul by Razvan Marin (Cagliari) and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle.
29' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
26' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

24' 1 - 0 Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the right post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.
20' A pass by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
14' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
13' Dodo (Fiorentina) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
12' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
12' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
12' David de Gea pulls off a great save to deny Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
10' Rough tackle by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

8' Golden chance! Dodo (Fiorentina) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
5' Marco Piccinini has a clear sight and sees a foul from Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
5' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
4' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
4' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
2' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Alen Sherri (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball. Fiorentina force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini is introduced as the referee for today's match.
